page_title: CLE 1-3 REN | Clermont v Rennes 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 1 - 3 Goal! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mory Diaw into the roof of the net.
90+6' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+6' Andy Pelmard (Clermont) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Eric Wattellier no option but to blow his whistle. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Rennes.
90+5' The game is interrupted. Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
89' That's a clear yellow card. Desire Doue (Rennes) goes into the book.
88' 1 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net and Desire Doue (Rennes) is the one who put it there!
87' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Rennes win a corner.
84' Substitution. Amine Gouiri walks off the pitch and Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
84' Here comes a substitution. Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) is brought on as a substitute for Shamar Nicholson.
84' Here is a change. Johan Gastien is going off and Pascal Gastien gives the last tactical orders to Yohan Magnin (Clermont).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Habib Keita as he is replaced by Maxime Gonalons (Clermont).
81' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.

81' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Mory Diaw makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Rennes force a corner. They send men into the box.
79' Eric Wattellier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Christopher Wooh (Rennes) and blew his whistle.
76' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
75' Julien Stephan has decided to make a change. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) replaces Martin Terrier.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arnaud Kalimuendo departs the field of play to be replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
74' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
73' Yellow card. Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
72' Clermont can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Clermont get a corner.
71' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the roof of the net. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Good work from Clermont as they win a corner.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aiman Maurer (Clermont) comes onto the pitch for Muhammed Cham.
66' The ball possession is 44:56.
62' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Mory Diaw easily deals with the threat.
58' The cross fools the defence and leaves Adrien Truffert (Rennes) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.
56' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
56' Problems for Julien Stephan as Jeanuel Belocian is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Adrien Truffert (Rennes) replaces him.

55' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.

52' Martin Terrier (Rennes) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the left side of the goal, but Mory Diaw pulls off a great save to deny him.
52' Martin Terrier (Rennes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
50' Martin Terrier (Rennes) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
49' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Julien Stephan makes a switch. Desire Doue (Rennes) is coming on in place of Mahamadou Nagida at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Arthur Theate (Rennes) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
45+4' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) prepares to take a corner kick.

45+4' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the top right corner, but Mory Diaw makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! It will be a corner kick for Rennes.
45+1' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont). He’s got to go!
45+1' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont)! Let's see what he decides.
45+1' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) for his blatant foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Looks like Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
38' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

37' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Clermont.

34' Habib Keita (Clermont) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
33' Having seen unsporting behavior, Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Gauthier Gallon (Rennes) is the recipient.

30' What a wasted opportunity by Amine Gouiri (Rennes)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Mory Diaw makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
29' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Eric Wattellier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' The total number of attempts is 5:5.
24' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.

20' Johan Gastien (Clermont) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Steve Mandanda!
19' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is able to continue to play.
18' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) picks up an injury.

17' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Steve Mandanda keeps the ball out.
13' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

13' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Clermont.
11' It looks like Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) saw red with that tackle. Eric Wattellier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
6' A rebound bounces out to Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
3' 1 - 0 Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
2' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier will referee today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
